Strasbourg ended four straight defeats by beating Auxerre 5-1. Strasbourg's league games have averaged four goals this season (17 scored, 19 conceded in 9).

Toulouse lose winger Aron Dønnum to suspension and on-loan Alexis Amougou (ineligible against his parent club), which slightly blunts them, but the Strasbourg factor points up.
